description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PdfEncryptionBase' which serves as a foundation for implementing different encryption versions for PDF security handling within the PDFsharp library. It provides abstract methods for initialization, encryption/decryption of objects, and password validation, along with utility methods and properties related to encryption handling.

classes.name: PdfEncryptionBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface and partial implementation for PDF encryption handlers in the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: InitializeFromLoadedSecurityHandler
methods.description: Initializes the encryption object with values from a loaded security handler.

methods.name: EnterObject
methods.description: Marks the start of an object for encryption or decryption processing.

methods.name: LeaveObject
methods.description: Marks the end of an object for encryption or decryption processing.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Encrypts the provided bytes for the currently entered object.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Decrypts the provided bytes for the currently entered object.

methods.name: PrepareEncryptionForSaving
methods.description: Prepares encryption parameters for saving, based on given passwords.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Validates an input password against the encryption scheme.

methods.name: HandleCryptographicExceptionOnDecryption
methods.description: Handles exceptions during decryption; logs a warning if configured to ignore errors.
